Non-Combatant.name: Non-Combatant
Non-Combatant.description:
🏃 You do not fight, and you have learned to survive anyway: spot danger early, get out of its way and get others to safety.

🌱 You notice danger early, keep people calm and moving, hide when there is nowhere to run, and bring help.
🎯 Suits civilians, Management and Support students, and anyone whose courage does not come from fists.
⚠️ You throw clumsy blows, cannot win a fair fight against a trained opponent and never give chase. None of the techniques harm anyone.
📈 You learn more techniques as your Dodging and Evacuation improve.
🤝 Civilians who stay to help are thanked on the news, and agencies hire them for evacuation. In a crew you are the lookout or the driver.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Dodging +15, Evacuation +10
⚡ Starting technique: Drop and Bolt
Non-Combatant.traitNarrativeEffects: No fighting training, and wants none. Instincts: notice danger early, move people away, hide, run for heroes or police. At start: dodges what they see coming and calms a frightened crowd, but throws clumsy blows, cannot win a fair fight against a trained opponent and never gives chase. If the player fights anyway, allow an untrained effort. No technique harms an opponent; all escape, hide, get help or get others out. Not cowardice: staying to guide others out is courage too. Same if Quirkless; a Quirk helps escape only through its own techniques. Running, dodging and hauling people cost stamina per technique tags; calming or directing people is free. Legal and social treatment: getting people out of danger is legal and praised; helpers make the news and get heroes' thanks; agencies hire them for evacuation and support. In a villain crew or beside a vigilante: lookout, driver, the one who always gets away. How it looks: alert, checks exits, phone in hand, calm voice.
